fact_text: PTC's subsidiary U Fone signed an agreement in June 2024 to acquire Telenor Pakistan, and the analyst also cited a 400 million dollar IFC loan linked to the deal.

fact_text: The Competition Commission is reviewing the U Fone acquisition, and the analyst said the deal would lift U Fone's market share to about 36 percent.

fact_text: The analyst said Pakistan's average revenue per unit and telecom tariffs are among the lowest in the world, so tariffs could rise and lift PTC's revenue.

fact_text: The analyst regards PTC as a major weighted stock after OGDC because of its paid-up capital, and expects telecom, broadband and cloud services to support its growth.

fact_text: At an analyst briefing on 23 October 2024, Mari Petroleum said its production profile had grown about 18 percent over past years.
